kind: v034 earned source-engine + focus-faithful simulated-DOM controller replay; NOT browser/layout/native keyboard/accessibility-tree acceptance

protocol.acquisition: Fresh fixed seed42, stage1 Balanced. Before each attempt equip the highest-scored already-owned item per slot (later item wins ties). Start, queue finishThenCamp, advance one-second source pulses until town/defeat or 1000 pulses. Retain losses/censors; no grants, sales, rerolls, binding, IW, AP, commissions, fabricated items, or extra attempts. Compare complete state and expedition reports with exact accepted v033 after every public action and pulse.
protocol.replay: Load the unchanged canonical earned save into v033 and v034 controller harnesses. Compare exact state, RNG, action log and tracked storage writes at each checkpoint. Inspect naturally earned axe/rapier/club IDs and the original unknown-family starter. Toggle only transient DOM disclosure state; exercise exact-ID rerender, summary focus, item switching, unrelated filter focus, readonly viewing and a normal source battle.
protocol.disclosureAdapter: The existing focus-faithful test DOM does not implement native summary focus or toggle. In this script only, createElement(summary) sets tabIndex=0 to model native focus capability; disclosure.open is set directly and a toggle event emitted. These adapters are explicitly not real keyboard/browser behavior and do not edit production or shared helper files.

effectText.unit: Unicode code points of the two effect prose paragraphs joined by one space; excludes headings, disclosure label, stats, actions and safety text. This is not a pixel, screen-height or scrolling measurement.
